title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.3
exact_target: Sharpen the integral-mean and coefficient bounds for weakly univalent functions, with the first-mean boundary-distance bound and linear coefficients as the stronger targets.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2305003 (AMR-022-5003). CC BY 4.0.

Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Chapter 5 introduction, equations (5.1)--(5.6), Problem 5.3, and complete Updates 5.1--5.3.
